invariants.title: Single-Root Repository and Runtime
invariants.statement: C:\Projekty\DevMaster\bartosz-dev-bridge-vnext and its runtime\ subdirectory are the sole canonical root; no dual long-lived AppData production copy exists.
invariants.notes: AppData retired; preserved bytes under recovery are non-authoritative evidence.

invariants.title: Repo-Local Native Messaging Manifest
invariants.statement: HKCU Native Messaging registry routes (both 32-bit and 64-bit) point to repo-local runtime manifest.

invariants.title: Client Promotion Source Binding
invariants.statement: Client promotion requires exact matching source_head and source_tree; promotion artifact is PyInstaller onedir windowless.

invariants.title: Post-Active Maintenance Fresh Verification
invariants.statement: Maintenance mutation requires fresh m11c_client_verification matching active source HEAD before mutation.

invariants.title: Static Admission Kill-Switch (M3c)
invariants.statement: M3c control v2 maintains static mode/kill-switch (INTERNAL_CANONICAL_ONLY) without dynamic intake projection.

invariants.title: Dynamic Writer/Intake Authority (M9b)
invariants.statement: M9b is the sole authority for active writer and intake state in production runtime.

invariants.title: Project Memory and Execution Authority Separation
invariants.statement: project-plan.json is immutable baseline history; runtime progress, cursors, and bindings belong strictly to Project Execution.
invariants.notes: Binding lifecycle uniqueness to be further hardened in NX-003.

invariants.title: Deterministic Acceptance Pipeline
invariants.statement: Canonical submission requires strict bdb-project-execution-submission-v1 schema and exact binding identity match.
invariants.notes: Full result identity versioning to be extended in NX-004.

invariants.title: Durable Launch Handoff & Exactly-Once
invariants.statement: Prompt handoff follows PENDING -> CLAIMED -> SENT/ACKED states to prevent duplicate sends across reloads.

invariants.title: Physical Send Confirmation & Focus Resilience
invariants.statement: AUTO send confirmation relies on physically observed DOM prompt submission (SEND_ATTEMPTED -> SEND_CONFIRMED -> ACKED), not window focus.

invariants.title: Fail-Closed on Identity / Correlation Mismatch
invariants.statement: Any mismatch in project_id, task_id, execution_binding_id, correlation_id or repo HEAD rejects execution and halts AUTO.

invariants.title: Replay Safety Without Duplicate Effects
invariants.statement: Exact semantic replay of an already accepted submission returns idempotent receipt without creating duplicate attempts.
